name: bug_slider_thumb_trail
description: SLIDER THUMB TRAIL: dragging the slider left old thumbs on the track. The widget slides its thumb with CallbackInfo::set_css_property(thumb, margin-left) on every pointer move (layout/src/widgets/slider.rs apply_cursor_value) — no rebuild, so the relayout is structure-preserved and the display list goes through the per-IFC PATCH, whose own damage (LayoutCache::last_patch_damage) is what the CPU backends repaint from. This scenario is that exact mechanism — the same CallbackChange::ChangeNodeCssProperties the widget emits — on a track+thumb DOM with the widget's own geometry (16px round thumb on a 200x16 rail), moved three times as a drag would. After every move, assert_damage_sound with pixel_identity compares the damage-driven framebuffer against an independent full repaint: a thumb ghost left at the vacated position is a pixel that should have changed and did not, which pixel_identity reports as a mismatch and the coverage half reports as UNDER-PAINT.

css: html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: white; }
#track { display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; flex-grow: 0; width: 200px; height: 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: #cccccc; }
#thumb { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-grow: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #0d6efd; margin-left: 0px; }
